newsitem.title: UK: Anglo-Welsh completes 2.2 mln stg placing.
newsitem.headline: Anglo-Welsh completes 2.2 mln stg placing.

text.p: Anglo-Welsh Group, the Bristol-based canal boat holiday operator, said on Tuesday it raised 2.2 million stg in a placing of new shares which will list on the London Stock Exchange's Alernative Investment Market (AIM).
Proceeds from the issue, which was oversubscribed, will be used to fund two acquisitions, increasing the company's fleet by 66 canal boats and expanding its boat building capability.

The money raised will also allow Anglo-Welsh to take advantage of British Waterways' stated objective of working with the private sector to develop the tourism and leisure potential of inland waterways in the UK.

Anglo-Welsh, which said it was the leading canal boat holiday operator in the UK by fleet-size and market share, manages bookings for 106 canal boats, of which it owns 69. They operate from nine bases in England and Wales.
The company's shares are scheduled to begin trading on the AIM market on Wednesday, February 26.
